_readme: Live result feeds. Every race uses the feeds listed for its state under stateFeeds and finds its contest automatically (contest: 'auto' matches any common spelling of 'U.S. House District N'). To add a source on election night, paste the results URL into the feed's url and save; the collector rereads this file on every pass. Override a single race under races, e.g. "NY-17": [{"feed": "rockland", "contest": "auto"}, {"feed": "westchester", "contest": "auto"}]. Adapters: ncsbe, clarity, enhanced-voting, fl-dos, delimited, json (see collector/adapters/*.js for their options).

nc.note: NC State Board of Elections statewide precinct file (verified: live, zero counts before polls close)

fl-dos.note: Florida DOS election-night file, county level. Add county Supervisor of Elections feeds for precinct detail.

ga.note: Georgia SOS (Enhanced Voting). Election ID from the site's own election list on Nov 3.

va.note: Virginia ELECT (Enhanced Voting). Election ID from the site's own election list on Nov 3.

sc.note: SC Election Commission on Clarity (www.enr-scvotes.org). The election is found from scvotes.gov/election-results by date and federal contests (127227, the newest link, is a State Senate special). The Clarity host often challenges GitHub; relay from home with --feeds sc.

co.note: Colorado SOS election night reporting (Clarity), linked from coloradosos.gov/pubs/elections/main.html on Nov 3. The Clarity host answers automated requests with a bot challenge, so this feed may stay blocked.

ia.note: Iowa SOS election night reporting (Clarity), 2026 General = IA/127077 (from the results site, Nov 3). The host often challenges GitHub; relay from home with --feeds ...,ia

ky.hint: Kentucky's results site (vrsws.sos.ky.gov/liveresults) refuses scripted requests from GitHub and home connections (HTTP 403). KY-06 is filled in from the AP call (config/calls.json).

in.note: Indiana Election Division results (enr.indianavoters.in.gov), county level. Office category 1005 = US Representative; file suffix from data/settings.json.

oh.note: Ohio SOS election-night XML (IEEE 1622.2 results format), county level.

pa.hint: Pennsylvania: county results pages (Bucks, Lehigh, Northampton, Monroe, Lackawanna, Luzerne...). One feed per county.

mi.hint: No automated source: the state results site (mvic.sos.state.mi.us) refuses scripted requests from GitHub and from home connections (HTTP 403), and mielections.us no longer answers. Set an adapter and url here if a usable county or state data file turns up.

mi-oakland.note: Oakland County Clerk results (Clarity), precinct level, found on elections.oaklandcountymi.gov by date and federal contests. Parts of MI-07 and MI-10. Relay from home with --feeds ...,mi-oakland

mi-eaton.note: Eaton County results (Clarity), precinct level, found on eatoncounty.org (MI/Eaton/127553 linked on Nov 3). MI-07. Relay from home with --feeds ...,mi-eaton

mi-vanburen.note: Van Buren County results (Enhanced Voting), precinct level, linked from vanburencountymi.gov. MI-04.

mi-shiawassee.note: Shiawassee County results (Enhanced Voting), precinct level, linked from shiawassee.net. MI-07.

mi-ingham.note: Ingham County results (Enhanced Voting), precinct level; the election ID is looked up by date from the county's election list. MI-07.

mi-macomb.note: Macomb County Clerk unofficial detailed results (Clarity), precinct level; linked from macombgov.org/departments/clerk-register-deeds/elections on Nov 3. Macomb is 250 of MI-10's 288 precincts. Clarity often challenges GitHub; relay from home with --feeds ...,mi-macomb

nj.hint: New Jersey: county clerks. One feed per county.

tx-harris.note: Harris County live results (app.harrisvotes.com), countywide by vote type; the Texas SOS file lagged Harris on election night.

tx-dallas.note: Dallas County election night reporting (Clarity, TX/Dallas/127396 linked from its Nov 3 results page; the site menu still pointed at an older election), precinct level; found by date. The Texas SOS file lagged the big counties on election night. Relay from home.

tx-tarrant.note: Tarrant County results (Clarity, TX/Tarrant/127297 linked Nov 3), precinct level; found by date. Relay from home.

tx-travis.note: Travis County results (Clarity, TX/Travis/127492, read from a browser on Nov 3: the county pages only link the Clarity root, which refuses scripts), precinct level. Relay from home.

tx.note: Texas SOS election-night results (Civix), county level. Election 53815 = 2026 November General.

me.hint: Maine reports by town after counting; use a town-level CSV if one is published.

ny.hint: New York: county boards (Rockland, Westchester, Putnam, Dutchess).

az.hint: Arizona: Maricopa / Pima / Pinal / Coconino county results files.

wi.hint: Wisconsin: county clerks (often CSV or PDF).

ca.hint: California: county registrars (Kern, Tulare, Kings; San Diego, Riverside).

oh-relay.note: Ohio results relayed from a home computer (collector/relay.js)

mi-relay.note: Michigan results imported by hand (collector/manual.js); trusted for 12 hours

mi-oakland-relay.note: Oakland County results relayed from a home computer

mi-eaton-relay.note: Eaton County results relayed from a home computer

tx-dallas-relay.note: Dallas County results relayed from a home computer

tx-tarrant-relay.note: Tarrant County results relayed from a home computer

tx-travis-relay.note: Travis County results relayed from a home computer

mi-macomb-relay.note: Macomb County results relayed from a home computer (collector/relay.js --feeds ...,mi-macomb)

sc-relay.note: South Carolina results relayed from a home computer (collector/relay.js --feeds oh,sc,co)

co-relay.note: Colorado results relayed from a home computer (collector/relay.js --feeds oh,sc,co)

ia-relay.note: Iowa results relayed from a home computer (collector/relay.js --feeds ...,ia)

ks.hint: Kansas SOS election night results (Senate race only on this board).

ak.hint: Alaska Division of Elections results (Senate race only on this board; polls close 12 am ET).
